requirement: The factoryContext shall contain the Manufacturer part.
The factoryContext shall contain the Customer part.
The factoryContext shall contain the Supplier part.
The Manufacturer shall contain Production, Storage, Sales, Procurement, ProductionScheduling, and Dispatch parts.
The Production part shall contain ProductionControl and AngleProductionLine parts.
The AngleProductionLine shall contain Heating, Bending, Cutting, Drilling, Grinding, and Polishing parts.
The AngleProductionLine shall connect materialIn to Heating.productIn.
The AngleProductionLine shall connect Heating.productOut to Bending.productIn.
The AngleProductionLine shall connect Bending.productOut to Cutting.productIn.
The AngleProductionLine shall connect Cutting.productOut to Drilling.productIn.
The AngleProductionLine shall connect Drilling.productOut to Grinding.productIn.
The AngleProductionLine shall connect Grinding.productOut to Polishing.productIn.
The AngleProductionLine shall connect Polishing.productOut to productOut.
The Production part shall connect ProductionControl.productionOrderOut to AngleProductionLine.productionOrderIn.
The Production part shall connect AngleProductionLine.productOut to productOut.
The Manufacturer shall connect Sales.salesOrderOut to ProductionScheduling.salesOrderIn.
The Manufacturer shall connect Sales.salesOrderOut to Dispatch.salesOrderIn.
The Manufacturer shall connect ProductionScheduling.productionOrderOut to Production.productionOrderIn.
The Manufacturer shall connect Production.materialOrderOut to Storage.materialOrderIn.
The Manufacturer shall connect Production.AngleProductionLine.productOut to Dispatch.productIn.
The Manufacturer shall connect Storage.materialOut to Production.materialIn.
The factoryContext shall connect Customer.inquiryOut to Manufacturer.Sales.inquiryIn.
The factoryContext shall connect Manufacturer.Dispatch.shippingConfirmationOut to Customer.shippingConfirmationIn.
The factoryContext shall connect Manufacturer.Sales.shippingConfirmationOut to Customer.shippingConfirmationIn.
The factoryContext shall connect Manufacturer.Sales.orderQuotationOut to Customer.orderQuotationIn.
The factoryContext shall connect Manufacturer.Sales.orderConfirmationIn to Customer.orderConfirmationOut.
The factoryContext shall connect Customer.shipmentIn to Manufacturer.Dispatch.shipmentOut.
The factoryContext shall connect Supplier.purchaseOrderIn to Manufacturer.Procurement.purchaseOrderOut.
The factoryContext shall connect Supplier.materialOut to Manufacturer.Storage.materialIn.
The factoryContext shall connect Manufacturer.Procurement.purchaseOrderOut to Supplier.purchaseOrderIn.
The ProductionControl part shall have an input port materialIn typed by MaterialPortDef.
The ProductionControl part shall have an input port productionOrderIn typed by ProductOrderPortDef.
The ProductionControl part shall have an output port material0 typed by MaterialPortDef.
The ProductionControl part shall have an output port productionOrderOut typed by ProductOrderPortDef.
The AngleProductionLine part shall have an input port materialIn typed by MaterialPortDef.
The AngleProductionLine part shall have an output port productOut typed by ProductPortDef.
The AngleProductionLine part shall have an input port productionOrderIn typed by ProductOrderPortDef.
The Storage part shall have an output port inventory typed by InventoryPortDef.
The Dispatch part shall have an output port shipmentOut typed by ShipmentPortDef.
The Supplier part shall have an input port purchaseOrderIn typed by PurchaseOrderPortDef.
